title: Seller Performance Standing Scale on the Northloop Payments Dispute Response Fee
content:
The base response fee withheld from the debit returned on a won Northloop Payments chargeback case is scaled by the seller's current level in Seller Performance Standing.

**Rule.** The base response fee is scaled by a standing fee multiplier of 0.5 when the seller's current performance standing level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level, 1.5 when it is Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level, and 1 at Standard Level or Above Standard Level.

| Current Seller Performance Standing level | Standing fee multiplier |
|---|---|
| Top Rated Level | 0.5 |
| Preferred Partner Level | 0.5 |
| Standard Level | 1 |
| Above Standard Level | 1 |
| Below Standard Level | 1.5 |
| Developing Seller Level | 1.5 |

The level read is the seller's current level on the Seller Performance Standing record.

*Hypothetical reading.* For a seller at Developing Seller Level the standing fee multiplier is 1.5; the same seller moved to Top Rated Level would carry 0.5.
